$comment: Constants the iOS and Android wallets MUST agree on. Token facts live in token.devnet.json (generated by solana/token/create-mint.js).

derivation.$comment: Solana standard BIP44 path. Account index varies for multiple accounts.

$genesis: Genesis gateway. Served publicly via Cloudflare Tunnel (gate.kvasir-ai.net, HTTPS, no router port-forward needed). Clients still auto-adopt /api/config.publicUrl if it ever changes.
$nodeGuide: Homepage node-operator guide (desktop installers + mobile store links). The web wallet can't run a node itself, so it hands off here via QR / download link. Must match kvasir-home LINKS.runNode and NODE_GUIDE_URL in wallet/desktop/src/api.ts.

solanaPay.$comment: Phase 2 inference-payment scheme. Kvasir issues a Solana Pay transaction request; the wallet signs and submits; Kvasir verifies on-chain by reference.
